acceptance_criteria: The Focusa-enhanced Pi light switch opens or focuses a Focusa-owned rich Mission Canvas webview/window over the same live Pi session and returns to stock Pi without state loss.
previous_claim: Mission Canvas replaces the complete visible Pi TUI when enabled and restores stock Pi when disabled without changing the live agent session.
invalidation_reason: The tested implementation is a Pi terminal TUI component rather than a Focusa-owned graphical webview/window.
The proof relied on handwritten assertions and source structure rather than a runtime rich-host traversal.
Workspace verticals, split panes, and C.R.I.S.T. stages were represented through terminal cards or transcript/Markdown output rather than the required rich renderers.
The implementation used reserved Cockpit naming for a Focusa/Pi surface.
The proof did not demonstrate rich-host accessibility, responsive behavior, reconnect, or visual verification through UIAI Engine Eval.
required_reproof: Pi invokes Canvas ON and launches or focuses focusa_pi_rich_window.
The same project, workstream, Session, Attachment, transcript, model stream, tools, Workpoint, Evidence, queues, and drafts survive ON/OFF.
The active Pi transcript renders as a live pi_session Work Surface inside the canonical Mission Canvas shell.
Actual Work Surface focus, grouping, rich splits, suspend, close, and rehydration execute against durable state.
Software, Legal, Markets, Research, General, and Custom profiles recompose complete professional layouts over identical canonical state.
C.R.I.S.T. stages render as interactive A2UI/Lit Work Surfaces rather than transcript messages.
UIAI Engine Eval produces responsive, accessibility, visual, reconnect, Evidence, and Receipt proof.
